name: Wavelet-Wigner-Hough method
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 结合文中所述变换实现轨道不平顺时频特征分析的方法。
usage_overview: 用于分析轨道不平顺的时频特征，通过结合小波分解与Wigner–Hough分析，识别不利不平顺区段的特征波长。

complete_examples.text: The Wavelet-Wigner-Hough method is a comprehensive method that effectively unites the wavelet theory and Wigner-Hough Transform method.
Readers who are interested in Wavelet-Wigner-Hough method can consult Refs. [24–28].
